tolerance_basis: Retrospective user acceptance of the already-observed shoulder1.41degree and elbow1.16degree endpoint errors. This replaces the acceptance criterion for local operational planning only; it is not a predeclared test success.
user_mounting_confirmation: User confirmed magnets centered/coaxial and rigidly attached to output shafts.

head.region_definition: Intersection of training bounds and both-direction heldout envelopes; extrapolated trials excluded. This is a sampled local region, not certification of every intermediate pose.

shoulder.region_definition: Intersection of training bounds and both-direction heldout envelopes; extrapolated trials excluded. This is a sampled local region, not certification of every intermediate pose.

elbow.region_definition: Intersection of training bounds and both-direction heldout envelopes; extrapolated trials excluded. This is a sampled local region, not certification of every intermediate pose.

limitations: No full mechanical-range or coordinated-path calibration is claimed.
Observed endpoint errors are not guaranteed upper bounds for future moves; payload, speed, direction history, sleep drift and joint coupling can change behavior.
The first elbow heldout began outside frozen training bounds; its endpoint error is reported but it is excluded from defining supported scope, without clipping or silent waiver.
The original frozen shoulder history label was corrected in the audit. Frozen parameters and original reports remain unchanged.
Physical microstep settings remain unverified; empirical pulse-to-reported-angle models do not certify motor-shaft RPM.
No firmware limit, stale-sensor guard, watchdog, sleep behavior or calibration loader state is changed.
